name: autonom-chatgpt-probe
description: Development probe for Autonom in ChatGPT desktop: checks MCP tools, the app bridge, model context, loopback media and H.264 decoding. Not part of the Autonom plugin.

interface.longDescription: A development-only plugin that measures what ChatGPT desktop allows a local Autonom integration to do: tool calls, the MCP Apps bridge, model context, loopback fetch and WebSocket, WebCodecs H.264 decoding and reconnects. Requires a local Autonom checkout or install, Python 3 and Node.
defaultPrompt: Open the Autonom probe and run all checks.
